'''Martin Falke Kashyyyk Ops Manipulator''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Martin Falke]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds88.htm Kashyyyk Ops Manipulator], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319181438/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds88.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
